card.line: Etam was a rocky place in Judah where Samson stayed in a cave, and the name also belongs to a town King Rehoboam built up for defense.

moments.title: Samson stays in the cave
moments.text: After Samson struck the Philistines with a great slaughter, he went down and stayed in the cave at the rock of Etam.

moments.title: Judah comes for Samson
moments.text: Three thousand men of Judah came to the cave at Etam to arrest Samson and give him to the Philistines. Samson let them tie him with two new ropes and lead him up from the rock.

moments.title: Rehoboam strengthens Etam
moments.text: King Rehoboam built up Etam with other cities in Judah for defense. He strengthened their fortifications and put officers, supplies, shields, and spears in them.
